speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To help me narrow down your condition, can you describe the specific nature of the flank pain and whether you have noticed any changes in your urination, such as frequency or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: The fatigue and fever persisting after your sinusitis treatment are concerning. Since the pain is in your flank, have you noticed any blood in your urine or a burning sensation when you urinate? This will help determine if the infection has spread to your kidneys.

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis caused by a beta-lactamase-producing organism (likely E. coli) resistant to amoxicillin and cephalexin. The fever, flank pain, and worsening symptoms after initial antibiotic treatment suggest the infection was not cleared and may have progressed to the kidneys. We need to confirm this immediately with a Urinalysis and Urine Culture, and I would also request blood tests (CBC and CMP) to assess kidney function and infection severity.
